note: The bases a person's own agent may be built on in the tenant project (docs/tenant-isolation-plan.md, technical debt 95). The deployment manager's install-package emits every person's package against this file and no other, so a package is built only on a base that lives in the tenant registry and carries the mesh adapter, which the tenant host needs to serve the agent. There is no harness base here on purpose: the tenant sandbox runs no harness yet, and a package whose work wakes one is refused at install rather than built onto a base that cannot run it.

bases.why: node plus the mesh adapter 0.99.7, carrying no key and no address, built in the tenant project by tenant-builder from bases/agentmesh. Every person's package is built on it, because the tenant host inside runs the adapter that holds the agent's key.
